title: Add WorldStateDiff unexpected-inventory-change detection (F31)
description:
## Finding F31 (Council: P1, 92% confidence)

WorldStateDiff currently detects inventory mismatches between predicted and actual outcomes but does not detect "unexpected" changes — inventory keys in the actual delta that were not in either the predicted gained or predicted lost sets. This means inventory changes from unmodeled sources (e.g., mob drops, other players, environmental pickup) are invisible to the diff.

## Effect
The observe→evaluate→replan loop misses inventory changes from non-tool sources. The evaluator may incorrectly conclude "all outcomes matched expectations" when the inventory has changed in ways the tool model didn't predict.

## Recommendation
Add `HasUnexpectedChanges` to `WorldStateDiff`:
1. After computing predicted gained/lost, cross-reference against actual inventory delta
2. Any key in ActualInventoryDelta not present in either gained or lost becomes an unexpected change
3. Expose this in the diff's DescribeMismatches() output
4. Surface in LlmEvaluatorImpl prompt context

This is a ~10-line addition with high observability value.
